note: Classical-baseline comparison for safety guarantees (heuristic reward clipping at path boundary) vs our verifiable SDP certificate (solve_lyapunov_sdp, unchanged). false_confidence=True marks gains where heuristic clipping reported >=90% of episodes 'safe' for a system that is mathematically unstable (spectral radius >= 1) — the SDP certificate never makes this mistake by construction (Schur stability is exactly rho(A)<1, the same fact the certificate solves for), and answers before running a single episode. This is NOT a claim that heuristic clipping always fails; near the stability boundary specifically, a short finite-horizon trial can look fine right up until it doesn't.
